briefdescription.para: Open with write-time encoding options (constant or average bit rate).

parameterdescription.para: Target kbps for CBR (Constant) or mean for ABR (Average). Not used for Variable.

briefdescription.para: Variable bit rate: libsndfile compression in [0,1] (0 = best quality, 1 = lowest). Maps to LAME VBR quality as in SFC_SET_COMPRESSION_LEVEL for SF_BITRATE_MODE_VARIABLE.

detaileddescription.para: For Mp3BitrateMode::Variable — same semantics as constructor (0 best, 1 worst).
After a successful SFM_WRITE open, codecs may tweak the encoder via sf_command. Default: no-op.
